_comment: Transcribed from the in-game customisation screens, captured 2026-08-06 (Steam captures 20260806011221-011900 and 023313-023457). name: Ribbed Vertical

description.text: Moderately reduces recoil at the cost of aim down sights (ADS) accuracy while moving.
